raw_text: Chinese hackers targeted India's power grid as troops faced off at LAC, reveals new research by Recorded Future. The Indian Express has independently verified that at least 10 power sector organizations were compromised using ShadowPad malware. The intrusions specifically targeted load despatch centres — the nerve centres that balance electricity supply and demand across India's grid in real time. Security researchers believe the campaign was designed to signal capability rather than cause immediate disruption. The timing correlation with the Galwan Valley clash in June 2020 is too precise to be coincidental.
